name: Icon
description: Face UI icon renderer. Built-in icons always render at 20x20; unsupported sources render notdef.

name.description: Built-in Face UI icon name. Unknown names render the notdef glyph.

label.description: Accessible label. If omitted, icon is decorative.

title.description: Optional title element for inline SVG.

notes: Icon inherits color through currentColor and does not own palette semantics.
Parent component slots may provide --uf-icon-size, but the rendered Icon DOM box remains 20x20.
Some built-in glyphs use --uf-color-background for internal knockouts; keep this tied to theme background until icon theming is formalized.
